as_told.title: Disappearance of retired Air Force General Neil McCasland
as_told.place_text: Quail Run Court, Albuquerque, New Mexico (Sandia foothills)

plain: Neil McCasland, a retired senior US Air Force general, is said to have gone missing from his home in New Mexico. Jesse Michels tells it several times. He says McCasland once ran the Air Force's research laboratory at Wright-Patterson base and sat on the committee that oversees the most secret military programs. He also says McCasland was a source for the musician Tom DeLonge's Secret Machines books, which DeLonge calls fiction but Michels treats as disclosure. In one episode Michels sets the scene: a late Friday morning, February 27, 2026, on Quail Run Court in Albuquerque, below the Sandia Mountains. He draws on a 911 call recording and the local sheriff's office. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell also brings it up, noting that a man "charged with protecting our national security" is missing. Michels raises it because a man with such secret knowledge vanishing would be strange.
